All metrics are judged by Amazon Mechanical Turk workers, who are shown a premise and two corresponding stories in random order: one generated by RE 3 and one by a baseline.
guideline: Workers compare two stories per premise and evaluate metrics individually or pairwise.
Workers compare two stories on interest, coherence, relevance (choosing which is better or neither), and individually mark each story for humanlikeness and writing issues.

For interest, coherence, and relevance, workers indicate which story is better, or that both or neither are good. For the remaining metrics (humanlike and writing issues), workers mark each story individually.
